shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air + faux-perspective depth, cross-level work/hauling/construction-supply/medical/prisoner-transport/recreation/modded-needs, DIRECT cross-level utilities (power, DBH, VEF/Helixien/VTE, Rimefeller), stairs/ladders/elevators, level-switch UI that keeps your build tool + optional camera-follow, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection/compile-time refs with clean signatures (foreign types in method BODIES only — the TypeLoadException rule; ENFORCED across all four foreign refs — BadHygiene, 0DubCore, PipeSystem, Rimefeller). Name-based registrations verified against shipped assemblies.
- **Detection is postfix-insensitive**: ALL soft-compat activity checks go through ABDetect.Active (ModLister.GetActiveModWithIdentifier ignorePostfix) — raw ModsConfig.IsActive misses local copies of workshop mods.
- **HarmonyBoot filters on [HarmonyPatch]**: only annotated classes reach CreateClassProcessor. GetTypes guarded against ReflectionTypeLoadException.
- **1.6 render-queue model (MEASURED, run #135)**: TerrainHard shader base 2000; terrain MATERIAL queue = base + renderPrecedence (rooftop tile 2230, soil 2340); Cutout/things+walls atlas = 2900; EdgeShadow 2950. Two orthogonal levers place custom map geometry: QUEUE (over-terrain-under-walls = max(terrain MATERIAL queues)+1 clamped Min(Cutout-1)) and DEPTH (cutout ZTest discards the EQUAL-depth LATER fragment). In user lore (textures).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid rock (vanilla NaturalRockTypesIn edifices), thick-roofed, 12C. Conservative animal policy. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL; removal via Remove gizmo or deconstruct.
- **Construction placement is left VANILLA**: placing a building over natural rock is rejected ("SpaceAlreadyOccupied") on EVERY map in pure RimWorld — CanPlaceBlueprintOver(edifice, mineable) returns false, and HandleBlockingThingJob only clears plants, never rock. This is not a basement-specific break, so per user decision we do NOT patch it (no auto-mine-on-build). Players mine basement rooms out first, then wall the boundaries, exactly like a vanilla mountain base.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase (0.6x quality-scaled), elevator (0.35x two-hop). Climb = Building_ABStairs.BaseClimbTicks (90) x type x quality x slider. Landing platforms footprint+1, air-reversion exempt.
- Stairs carry PAWNS ONLY (tickerType Never, no comps). All utilities cross through dedicated utilityOnly links.

## DIRECT cross-level utilities
- **Vanilla power — vertical conduit**: CompABGridLink : CompPowerTrader. Master side recomputes every 15t, nets a single signed flow across the pair. Deficits served from far generation surplus AND far stored energy. Rimatomics electricity rides vanilla PowerNet so it crosses automatically.
- **VEF PipeSystem — vertical duct** (Vanilla Pipes Expanded, Helixien gas, VTE ACNet): net pairs matched by def; unmet demand injected via PipeNet.ExtraProduction/ExtraConsumptionThisTick. Def gated by PatchOperationFindMod.
- **DBH — vertical water pipe**: each end carries CompPipe(Water) + hidden 100L storage; damped fill-fraction equalization. Sewage per-level.
- **Rimefeller — vertical chem pipe (USER-VERIFIED in-game)**: two hidden 100-unit CompStorageTank per end (Oil + Fuel); equalization via PullOil/PushCrude/PullFuel/PushFuel.
- Dispatcher ABPipeCompat: ABDetect flags, per-def ext routing, driven from ground LevelComp every 100t.

## Sky surface model (VERIFIED runs #121-#123)
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule + time-sliced sweep.
- Rooftop renders the vanilla steel tile texture tinted dark steel; tiles to the outer wall edge; full buildability. Mountain edge maps below natural-roof rock to AB_MountainTop with a fog-mirroring pair. Sky auto-roof guard on AutoBuildRoofAreaSetter.

## See-below renderer (printed things + faux perspective + slab skirt + fake zoom out) — ALL USER-VERIFIED
- Things content PRINTED PER CELL (SectionLayer_ABBelowThings), covered cells print nothing (roof opacity by construction). Faux-perspective depth transform p' = k*p + (1-k)*cam + (0, BelowOffset, -depthShift). Slab-edge skirt. Fake zoom out (belowThingScale, USER-VERIFIED). Rooftop rim wall reveal (USER-VERIFIED #133). Slab-edge wall facade (clipped-sliver, USER-VERIFIED). [diag #133] line REMOVED. Zero cost when the sky map is not current.

## Level view + camera (UI) — USER-VERIFIED 2026-07-20
- All level switches funnel through LevelCamera.JumpPreservingView (keeps camera pos+zoom). Entry points: PageUp/PageDown hotkeys, the level-view widget buttons, stairs/elevator ride gizmos.
- **Architect stays put across level switches (BUG2, USER-VERIFIED)**: MapInterface.Notify_SwitchedMap deselects the active designator and rebuilds the Architect window from scratch on every CurrentMap change. ABArchitectPreserve.Around wraps every LevelCamera switch: snapshots the open category (MainTabWindow_Architect.selectedDesPanel.def) + selected designator (Find.DesignatorManager.SelectedDesignator) BEFORE the jump, and after (vanilla has reopened the tab via SetCurrentTab) rebinds the matching category panel (reflection over private desPanelsCached, matched by def) and re-Selects the designator. Fails open.
- **Camera follows a colonist through stairs (BUG3, USER-VERIFIED — toggle cameraFollowStairs, default ON)**: LevelCamera.FollowPawn switches the view to the pawn's arrival level centered on them at current zoom and keeps them selected. Wired in StairTransfer.Transfer, gated to fire ONLY when this exact pawn is Find.Selector.SingleSelectedThing, is a player-faction non-animal, and the player is viewing the level being left. Never yanks the camera for AI haulers, pulled pets, or hostiles. Multi-hop elevator rides follow each hop. Also runs through ABArchitectPreserve.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics: haul/fetch/demand-pull/export-pin/carried-delivery; column-aware stuff picker.
- **Cross-level SUPPLY FETCH (toggle crossLevelSupply, default ON, USER-VERIFIED)**: fixes "can't build in the basement when materials are upstairs." The demand model was PUSH-ONLY; the FETCH giver only scanned listerHaulables which EXCLUDES stockpiled materials. WorkGiver_ABFetchFromOtherLevels now also fires when the pawn's OWN level has unmet CrossLevelDemand (blueprints/frames/bills/patient+prisoner meals) for a def in stock on a linked level (CrossLevelDemand.FindFetchableDemand/HasFetchableDemand, ExportAllowed-guarded, reachability inside the virtual swap); stashes an ABPendingOrders action that on arrival issues the existing AB_HaulAcrossLevels back down.
- NEEDS ACROSS THE COLUMN: rest, food, RECREATION, need/state engine. Public ABApi.RegisterNeedJobGiver.
- Medical rescue three ways; capture; one-colony UI; ABPendingOrders.
- **Cross-level PRISONER TRANSPORT (toggle crossLevelPrisoners, default ON, USER-VERIFIED)**: fixes "can't bring a prisoner to a prepared basement cell." New job AB_TakePrisonerAcrossLevels reuses JobDriver_ABTakePawnAcrossLevels (downed-only FailOn relaxed for the prisoner def — vanilla EscortPrisonerToBed carries awake prisoners) + CarriedIntent.Imprison; FinishCarriedDelivery queues vanilla EscortPrisonerToBed (awake) / TakeWoundedPrisonerToBed (downed). AUTOMATIC via WorkGiver_ABWardenTakeToBedAcrossLevels (workType Warden, priorityInType 85 < vanilla 90): fires when no usable local prison bed OR the prisoner OWNS a bed on a directly linked level. PLUS a right-click order.

## Performance architecture
- ALL LevelComp cadences use elapsed-time nextDue scheduling. Hidden-level throttling; colonist-bar reorder postfix; faux-perspective transform one lazy rebuild. Supply fetch rides the fetch giver's 450t empty-scan cooldown + 600t demand cache; warden cross-level giver only scans when prisoners exist. Architect preserve + camera follow are one-shot UI work at switch time only. Zero recurring cost with no levels.

## Mod compatibility (Docs/CompatMatrix.md)
- EXPLICIT: VEF pipes, DBH, Rimefeller (USER-VERIFIED in-game), Open The Windows, Vehicle Framework, Hospitality, Common Sense, RJW, Intimacy, Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: column queries; GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward; events; RegisterExitDuty; RegisterNeedJobGiver.
- XML: ABStairsExtension; ABIncidentLevelPolicy.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip; async mask lag; freestanding unroofed walls below visible from above (locked). Faux perspective + skirt + scale caveats.
- Construction: building over natural rock rejected everywhere (vanilla lock, not patched) — mine basement rooms first.
- Supply fetch: loose delivery lands near the arrival stairs; if the demanded stack is claimed mid-trip the fetch fails open; only directly linked levels searched.
- Prisoner transport: awake prisoner is carried (vanilla escort behavior); auto-move only when no local cell OR bed owned on a linked level; mounted/aggro excluded.
- Camera follow: only follows a single-selected pawn while you view the level being left; elevator chains jump per hop.
- Utilities: DBH sewage per-level; VEF turn-on cascade; hidden sky weather lag.

## Status
2026-07-20: cross-level supply fetch, cross-level prisoner transport, BUG2 architect-state preservation, BUG3 camera-follow-through-stairs, the wall facade (clipped-sliver), fake zoom out, and Rimefeller compat are ALL USER-VERIFIED working in-game. BUG1 (build-over-rock) confirmed a vanilla lock, left untouched per user. [diag #133] line stripped. The whole see-below renderer and level-view/camera UI are now fully verified. ONLY OPEN ITEMS: T9 soak (long-duration stability/leak/save-load/perf-drift burn-in — needs real playtime, not a scripted trigger) and T5 publishing prep.
